name: Trapani (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Trapani drawn in yellow: a castle with a scythe above waves.
history: Municipal flag of Trapani, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 11 August 1928.

features.role: crowned castle with a scythe above waves (the arms of Trapani)
